text:
andrew: Morning folks — idea: "8K + boulder" lunchtime challenge tomorrow. Run an 8k loop from the office to CragHouse, then 30 mins of problems. Loser buys granola bars? :running: :climbing:
jess: I'm tempted. Can I cut the run to 4k and meet you at the bridge? leg's still cranky.
andrew: totally — plan is flexible. start at 12:15 from lobby, anyone can hop off at the bridge (~4k).
tina: count me in for bouldering only, can't run after my physio. will still stomp the topouts :muscle:
marco: route suggestion: office -> river path -> old mill -> CragHouse. flat, shaded, ~8.1k. quick Strava route: https://strava.app.link/route/8kloop123
strava-bot: New route saved: "Riverside Loop to CragHouse" (8.12 km, est 50-55 min walk/run).
kelly: Snack logistics — I'm vegan. can we swap granola for a fruit box? :leafy_green:
andrew: good call, fruit box it is. loser gets boxed kombucha too. :grin:
jess: will bring a tiny first-aid kit just in case. also: anyone want to try a 3-min plank after the climb for bragging rights? :sweat_smile:
marco: 😂 yes. plank-off sounds dangerously fun.
andrew: quick poll: react with :running: to join full run+climb, :biking: to meet at bridge (4k), :climbing: to boulder-only. I'll tally at 11:45.
tina: :climbing:
kelly: :climbing:
jess: :biking:
marco: :running:
andrew: Awesome. See lobby 12:15 for runners. Bridge folks ping here when you start. If you're late, we leave at 12:20 sharp. :alarm_clock: 
kelly: bringing rope tape and chalk balls for shared holds. anyone allergic?
andrew: none reported. safe bet. last note: leave valuables in locker or desk. lockers open code `4812` (office admin okayed).
tina: locking phone in locker, see you y'all. :wave:
andrew: perfect. small reminder: pace is casual, no pressure — it's for fun. pics encouraged. :camera_with_flash:
strava-bot: Reminder set for 11:50 to post meetup ping.
jess: pumped. granola losers beware. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
